title: Docs footer links Contact us to the Anthus engage page
description: Pass --contact-url to the docs site build so the Anthus family footer's Contact us link goes to https://anth.us/engage/?solution=Biblicus&cta=docs. Depends on the Papyrus docs_site footer PR.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Docs site footer: Papyrus PR 575 added --contact-url to the shared builder; Biblicus hotfixes #111 and #113 to main (pin papyrus-newsroom 5.31.0) put Contact us -> https://anth.us/engage/?solution=Biblicus&cta=docs on every docs page, verified live 2026-10-22 (HTTP 200). API reference: PR 114 adds the link with cta=api-reference via html_context; goes live with the 1.16.0 release. PR 110 superseded by the hotfixes.
